context.content_translation:
波茨茅斯的农业产业一直找到方法，通过种植不同的作物和开拓新市场来……自己。
A. 再投资
B. 重用
C. 重新评估
D. 重塑

items.question: Portsmouth’s agricultural industry has always found ways to ------- itself by growin different crops and finding new markets.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“reinvent”代入题干后为“Portsmouth’s agricultural industry has always found ways to reinvent itself by growin different crops and finding new markets.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：D（reinvent）。
